findings.failureScenario: A macOS RightKitLicense client activates a lease, but the payload labels the host as iOS because the non-UIKit branch returns the literal iOS platform name. A lease service that routes, scopes, or audits entitlements by platform can apply iOS policy to a macOS client or reject the request.
findings.action: Return an explicit macOS label in the macOS branch and keep iOS/iPadOS labels in UIKit branches. Add payload assertions for macOS, iOS, and iPadOS so each shipped platform label is qualified independently.
